catalogue.name: Crocin DS Syrup
catalogue.about: A paracetamol syrup for fever and mild pain in children.

catalogue.name: Meftal-P Syrup
catalogue.about: A syrup for pain and fever in children. It also contains paracetamol.

catalogue.name: Ephodrex Syrup
catalogue.about: A syrup for cough and chest congestion.

catalogue.name: Paracetamol 500 mg
catalogue.about: A tablet for fever and mild pain.

catalogue.name: Amoxicillin 500 mg
catalogue.about: An antibiotic for bacterial infections. It must be finished as prescribed.

catalogue.name: Cetirizine 10 mg
catalogue.about: A tablet for allergies, itching and a runny nose.

catalogue.name: Ibuprofen 400 mg
catalogue.about: A tablet for pain and inflammation, taken after food.

catalogue.name: Omeprazole 20 mg
catalogue.about: A capsule that reduces stomach acid, taken before a meal.

catalogue.name: Oral Rehydration Salts
catalogue.about: A powder mixed in water to replace fluids and salts after vomiting or loose motions.
